assign.request: One fix to your PageFiles work: folders that arrive by a git merge get no page.jsonl (core/Page/jsonl/doc/ had none after the merge) because the watcher only syncs folders whose log already exists and no addDir event fires for them. Fix in Server/plugins/PageFiles.js: when any event lands in a folder the rule covers with no page.jsonl yet, create it with its full listing first, then carry on. Prove with a one-command tree copy (3 nested sub-folders, 4 logs must appear), delete (gone line), 5 reads add 0 lines. Commit by exact path. Report: 2 lines, commit id + proof counts.
assign.now: reading the merge-arrival bug, planning the fix
steps: fix handle() to ensure(dir) before sync, so any surviving event in a logless covered folder backfills it
boot a private server, prove: one-command copy of a 4-folder tree -> 4 logs appear
prove delete -> gone line in the parent

log.msg: task-loop chase 1 of 2: left to heartbeat

log: fix: handle() now also calls ensure(dir) on the CONTAINING folder of whatever event survives, not just ensure(file) on the changed entry -- so a whole new subtree landing at once (git merge/checkout) self-heals from a single surviving event anywhere inside it, since ensure()->catchup() does a full readdir, not just the one entry that triggered it. No parent-walk needed: creating a folder's page.jsonl is itself a new-file event the existing PAGE branch already reacts to.

proof (private port 53796, NO_SUPERVISE=1): fs.cpSync of a 4-folder tree (top + 3 nested, one file each) in ONE call -> logs_found=4/4. 5 reads of the deepest file -> 0 new lines. Deleting the tree -> a gone line appended to the parent. Cleaned up the test folder and surgically removed the 3 test lines from the parent's page.jsonl afterward (it had pre-existing uncommitted drift from the live worktree server, same care as the first task).

re-ran Server/page-files-backfill.mjs against the real tree: 2,891 folders visited, 14 logs created (including the reported core/Page/jsonl/doc/), 50 lines appended; a second run right after: 0 and 0 (idempotent, unchanged).

decision.question: whether to commit the ~213 page.jsonl files now showing as changed in the worktree (mostly M, some ??) alongside the code fix
options: sweep all of them into a data commit, like the first task's backfill commit
commit only the code fix, by exact path, as asked
decision.why: this worktree has ~24 other active Claude sessions on it right now (checked via ListAgents) and the live server (:53780, auto-restarted onto my fix) is correctly reacting to THEIR real, ongoing, legitimate edits in real time -- most of the 213 files are that normal traffic, not something my backfill run produced, and sweeping it all into this commit would misattribute other people's concurrent work to this fix. The one concrete regression named (core/Page/jsonl/doc/) is fixed and verified; a full backfill-data commit is a separate, later concern once the worktree is quiet
decision.rule: the owner's own instruction: "commit by exact path"
